operations: Define and test pure Kotlin money arithmetic and exact locale-aware parsing boundaries.
Define and test UTC reporting intervals from injected calendar context without resolving open product policy.
Define deterministic clock, ID, locale, and timezone abstractions.
planner.rollback: Changes are additive and confined to BT-006-owned task, pure-domain, test, and evidence files. Preserve all pre-existing files and revert only the recorded BT-006 additions or line edits if review rejects them.

securityPreflight.scope: Additive pure Kotlin domain primitives and JVM tests only: signed-Long Money/CurrencyCode arithmetic; exact explicit-Locale and currency numeric parsing; UTC half-open calendar intervals and explicit prior calendar units with supplied ZoneId/week start; deterministic supplied Clock/UUID inputs. No UI, persistence, database, export, overlay, networking, telemetry, dependency upgrades, reporting-policy selection, or destructive operations.

findings.description: DecimalFormat full-consumption checks do not prove valid grouping. Acceptance tests must cover malformed grouping, and implementation must validate locale grouping syntax and convert with exact BigDecimal operations without rounding.
Check currency equality before checked arithmetic; cover positive and negative overflow, and reject Long.MIN_VALUE negation if exposed.
Resolve every local date boundary independently for DST-safe intervals; verify half-open endpoints, leap/month/year boundaries, 23/25-hour days, and explicit calendar adjacency.
Require explicit locale, currency, timezone, week start, clock, and UUID inputs; do not call global defaults or infer policy.
D-02 and D-05 remain unresolved. Do not select reporting timezone, infer onboarding currency, define currency-change behavior, or claim SPEC-003 acceptance.
No financial input logging or Android, persistence, networking, or telemetry dependencies; run only planned scoped verification and record unavailable checks honestly.
